prompt.text:
Implement a new TypeScript module exporting `ShelfItem` and `RecordShelf`.

`ShelfItem` has `id: number`, `label: string`, and `tags: string[]`. `RecordShelf` must expose `add(item): boolean`, `get(id): ShelfItem | null`, `update(item): ShelfItem | null`, `remove(id): ShelfItem | null`, and `list(): ShelfItem[]`.

IDs must be positive safe integers, labels must contain a non-whitespace character, and every tag must be a string. Invalid items or IDs throw `TypeError` or `RangeError` as appropriate. Valid labels and tags are preserved exactly. `add` returns `false` for a duplicate ID without modifying the existing item. `update` returns `null` for a missing ID; otherwise it replaces that item and returns a copy of the previous value without changing insertion order. `remove` behaves similarly and removes only the matching item. `list` uses insertion order.

The shelf must copy incoming objects and tag arrays. Every returned item and tag array must also be a fresh copy, so callers cannot mutate stored state through aliases. An empty shelf lists as a fresh empty array.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
